title: Goodness-of-fit for distributions on metric spaces
summary: We propose a general goodness-of-fit framework for distributions on separable metric spaces. Under suitable identifiability conditions, probability distributions are characterized by distance profiles, which motivates their use in goodness-of-fit testing, for simple and composite null hypotheses. For composite null hypotheses, parameter estimation is incorporated via a Bahadur-type expansion, and the asymptotic distribution of the empirical process for distance profiles is obtained under the null.
